page.layout: One page of text in two columns of lexicon entries, with the Hebrew running head at top centre and the page number at top right. A catchword stands alone at the lower right.

main_text.p: שָׁלַם Compleri, Perfici: Pacem habere vel colere, Pacem precari. Salutare: Pihel שִׁלֵּם Perficere, Complere: Perfolvere, Reddere, Rependere, Retribuere. Pyhal שֻׁלַּם Rependi, Retribui. Hiphil הִשְׁלִים Perfecit, Absolvit: Pacem fecit vel iniit. Hoph. הָשְׁלַם Pacatum effici.
שָׁלֵם m. Chald. Perfectum, Absolutum, Esr. 5.16. Ex Aphel וְהִשְׁלְמוּ Et perfecit illud, Dan.5.26. Imper. הַשְׁלֵם Redde, Esr 7.19.
שְׁלוֹם m. Retributio: plur. שְׁלוֹמִים . Fœmin. sing. שְׁלוֹמָה . שְׁלֵם m. idem.
שָׁלֵם m. Integer, Integrum, Perfectum, Complet um: plur. שְׁלֵמִים . Fœm. sing. שְׁלֵמָה plur. שְׁלֵמוֹת .
שֶׁלֶם m. Sacrificium eucharisticum sive pacificum: plur. שְׁלָמִים .
שָׁלוֹם m. Pax, Prosperitas, Integritas: plural. שְׁלוֹמִים Pacifici.
שְׁלָם, שְׁלָמָא m. Chald. idem: שְׁלָמְכוֹן Pax vestra, Dan.3.31.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate in several entries and may not match the printed pointing exactly. The Hebrew forms in the first entries and the Chaldee forms are the least certain. The running head and catchword are Hebrew and were read from a small scan.
